title: Follow us to City Hall!
description:
You are invited to help shape next year's budget. Make your voice heard at City Hall tonight during a 6 p.m. public meeting focused on the fiscal year 2027 budget. 

You can come to the City Administration Building (located at 202 C Street) and head up to the Council Chambers on the 12th floor. You can also call in remotely to the Council meeting, and tune in on CityTV via the webstream at SanDiego.gov or channel 24 in City limits. 

Another way to share your input is through our Resident Budget Survey. Visit sandiego.gov/BudgetSurvey. It only takes a few minutes, and the survey is available in English and Spanish.

#BudgetSurvey #SanDiego
